facts.content: Patient has breathing difficulty after a wasp sting approximately 15 minutes ago.
facts.source_text: CC: Breathing difficulty after wasp sting ~15 min ago

facts.content: The wasp sting occurred while gardening and the patient ran indoors.
facts.source_text: Wasp sting while gardening; ran indoors

facts.content: The patient is experiencing shortness of breath with shallow breaths and chest tightness.
facts.source_text: SOB with shallow breaths; chest tightness

facts.content: The patient has lip tingling but denies throat tightness or closure.
The patient developed a blotchy rash.
The patient has no history of similar reactions.
Patient has a history of eczema.
Patient has a history of aerosinusitis.
Patient has over-the-counter antihistamines for flying but has not taken any yet.
facts.source_text: Meds: Has OTC antihistamines (used for flying); none taken yet

facts.content: Patient's wife was present during the call.
Acute allergic reaction after a wasp sting with respiratory symptoms, lip paresthesia, and blotchy rash; risk of anaphylaxis.
facts.source_text: Acute allergic reaction after wasp sting with respiratory symptoms (SOB, chest tightness), lip paresthesia, and blotchy rash; risk of anaphylaxis.
Wife to call EMS/ambulance immediately (initiated during call)

facts.content: Patient advised to take oral antihistamine now while awaiting EMS.
facts.source_text: Take oral antihistamine now while awaiting EMS

facts.content: Urgent emergency department evaluation; transport via ambulance not private car.
facts.source_text: Urgent ED evaluation; transport via ambulance (not private car)

facts.content: Advised that symptoms can worsen quickly and to go to hospital straight away.
facts.source_text: Advised symptoms can worsen quickly; go to hospital straight away
